title: Re-Entry
author: Mary Goodden
description:
Since you left your small hometown to move to London, nothing's gone to plan. Your girlfriend moved out, your video game career hasn't materialised, and the things you thought you'd left behind keep coming back to haunt you.

Your Dad's just died, and you're back in town for the funeral. Will you make it through the day without letting everyone see what a mess you are? Can you resist telling your stepmother what you really think of her? Are you brave enough to apply for your dream job? And why did you put that little bag in your pocket this morning?

Features:

  • Build (or destroy) relationships with your friends and family.
  • Retreat to your phone to send texts, emails, and, well, that's it really. You couldn't afford a better phone. You're not very successful.
  • Come to terms with your complicated feelings about your friends, your family, your ex, your career, and yourself. Or, like, don't.
